items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: That one you made for Charlie.

ctx.x: Oh, no, it wasn't good as that, Mr. Bill. That one you made for Charlie. Yeah, it wasn't good, you see? It wasn't made out of a kind of cheap kind of wood, you see? You make them out of good oak. Good oak, yes. A piece of flooring, wasn't it? That's the best. Yeah. You see, you get more of a, what you call it. It's a good snap to a hill. Yeah, better, yeah, you see? So, and another thing, Mr. Bill, I bought a derby. It was a luminal derby. You know what I mean? It's whatever for your trumpet, you know what I…
Did you hold it or have it on a rack?
